adjuster_notes: Site visit 2024-03-15. Kitchen flooding from burst copper supply line beneath sink. Pipe age approximately 30 years, original installation. No prior water claims on file. Damage assessment: drywall replacement $2,800, cabinet refacing $1,950, flooring $1,400. Policyholder cooperative, photos taken.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10001: Burst copper supply line caused kitchen flooding on 2024-03-15. Pipe ~30 years old, original install. Damage estimate totals $6,150. Excess $1,500.00 applies. Coverage under HO-0304 WD-1 sudden and accidental discharge.

adjuster_notes: Inspection conducted 2024-04-22. Roof shingles stripped by Hurricane Idalia remnants. NHC designated storm. Wind speed recorded at 78 mph local station. Structural damage to south-facing dormer. Temporary tarp placed. Estimate for full reroof: $18,500. Named storm deductible applies per HO-0305.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10002: Hurricane Idalia remnants caused roof and dormer damage on 2024-04-22. NHC-named storm. Reroof estimate $18,500. Named Storm deductible $5,000 applies per HO-0305 NS-2.

adjuster_notes: Field visit 2024-05-10. Bathroom ceiling shows brown water staining spreading over ~3 weeks from slow drip above. Plumber confirmed gradual leak from second-floor toilet wax seal. No sudden event. Damage limited to ceiling drywall and paint. Repair estimate $1,200.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10003: Gradual water leak from toilet wax seal caused ceiling staining over ~3 weeks, discovered 2024-05-10. Repair estimate $1,200. Excess $1,000.00. Note: may fall under E-11 gradual seepage exclusion if leak exceeded 14 consecutive days.

adjuster_notes: Loss reported 2024-06-03. Automatic fire sprinkler head activated accidentally during attic renovation, discharged water for approximately 45 minutes before shut-off valve located. Water damage to second floor bedrooms and stairwell. No fire present. Contractor estimates $9,700 in water damage restoration.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10004: Accidental sprinkler discharge during attic renovation on 2024-06-03. Water ran ~45 min. Damage to bedrooms and stairwell, restoration estimate $9,700. Excess $1,500.00. Covered under HO-0304 WD-1 (automatic fire protective sprinkler system).

adjuster_notes: Adjuster notes 2024-07-14. Washing machine overflow in laundry room. Appliance is 18 years old, no service records available. Water spread to adjacent hallway and living room carpet. Estimated damage $3,400 for carpet replacement and baseboard repair. Policy shows Coverage A limit $350,000.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10005: Washing machine overflow on 2024-07-14. Appliance 18 years old, no service records. Carpet and baseboard damage, estimate $3,400. Excess $1,500.00. Risk of E-16 exclusion (appliance over 15 years, no service record).

adjuster_notes: Investigation 2024-03-28. Policyholder reports burst pipe in guest bathroom wall. Turned out to be main service entry pipe outside the dwelling footprint. Water entered through foundation wall. Plumber repaired external section. Interior damage minimal — $800 drywall patch.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10006: Pipe burst at main service entry on 2024-03-28. Damage was external to dwelling; interior drywall patch $800. Excess $1,000.00. Note: supply line definition (WD-2) starts at main service entry — external pipe may not qualify.

adjuster_notes: Visit 2024-08-05. Heavy rain followed by Category 2 hurricane. Insured filed for roof and siding repairs. Total estimate $22,000. However, pre-storm inspection photos from March show existing shingle lifting on north face. North-face damage $6,000 of total. Coverage A $400,000, so named storm deductible is $8,000 (2%). Recommend separating pre-existing from storm damage.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10007: Category 2 hurricane damage to roof and siding on 2024-08-05. Total estimate $22,000 but $6,000 north-face damage is pre-existing (E-23). Named Storm deductible $8,000 (2% of $400K Coverage A). Net payable to be determined after pre-existing separation.

adjuster_notes: Notes 2024-09-12. Policyholder discovered dishwasher supply hose had been dripping behind cabinetry. Plumber estimates leak duration at 4-6 weeks based on moisture meter readings in subfloor. Mold visible on cabinet backing. Remediation company quoted $7,200 for mold removal plus $3,100 for cabinet and subfloor repair.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10008: Dishwasher supply hose leak over 4-6 weeks discovered 2024-09-12. Mold found. Total estimate $10,300. Excess $1,500.00. Water leak likely exceeds 14-day threshold (E-11). Mold remediation may be excluded under E-22 if underlying water event not covered.

adjuster_notes: Claim filed 2024-04-17. Denial recommended. Policyholder submitted claim for mold remediation after discovering black mold in basement. Investigation reveals mold was present when policy was issued — home inspection report from 2023-11-10 notes 'visible mold growth in basement utility room.' No covered water event preceded the mold. Remediation quote $14,000.
denial_reason: Pre-existing mold present at policy inception per home inspection report dated 2023-11-10
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10009: DENIED. Mold remediation claim filed 2024-04-17. Mold was pre-existing per 2023-11-10 home inspection. Exclusion E-26 (pre-existing mold at time of policy issue) applies. Remediation quote $14,000 not payable.

adjuster_notes: Review 2024-06-20. Insured operates a licensed massage therapy practice from home studio, 25+ clients per week. Client fell on wet floor in hallway, filed bodily injury claim against insured. Liability claim $45,000. Home is clearly primary place of business. In-home office exception does not apply per CLAUSE BP-2 condition.
denial_reason: Dwelling is primary place of business; in-home office exception (BP-2) explicitly does not apply
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10010: DENIED. Bodily injury from client fall on 2024-06-20. Insured's home is primary place of business (massage therapy, 25+ clients/week). Exclusion E-19 (business pursuits) applies. BP-2 in-home office exception does not apply. Liability claim $45,000 not covered.

adjuster_notes: Inspection 2024-07-30. Foundation cracks appeared following two months of drought then heavy rain. Engineer report identifies expansive clay soil causing foundation heave. Crack width 8mm in living room wall, 5mm in garage slab. Repair estimate $28,000 for foundation underpinning. Insured argues this is water damage, not earth movement.
denial_reason: Foundation damage from expansive soil — classified as earth movement under broadened definition
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10011: DENIED. Foundation cracking from expansive clay soil, discovered 2024-07-30. Exclusion E-34 (expansive soil and shrinkage) applies under HO-0308. Despite insured's argument, this is earth movement under EM-1 broadened definition. Repair estimate $28,000 not covered.

adjuster_notes: Claim 2024-05-25. Mudslide after heavy spring rains destroyed detached garage and damaged main dwelling foundation. County declared natural disaster. Insured has HO-0308 endorsement. Mudslide damage clearly falls under earth movement. Total damage estimate $67,000.
denial_reason: Mudslide is earth movement — excluded under HO-0308 broadened definition regardless of triggering event
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10012: DENIED. Mudslide destroyed detached garage and damaged foundation on 2024-05-25. Exclusion E-35 (mudslide and debris flow) applies under HO-0308. County disaster declaration does not override policy exclusion. Total damage $67,000 not covered.

adjuster_notes: Notes 2024-08-15. Insured runs home day care for 8 children. One child sustained injury on playground equipment in backyard. Parents filed suit. Insured's CGL does not cover residential operations. Seeking coverage under homeowners policy HO-0309. Day care operation is licensed.
denial_reason: Home day care operation excluded under CLAUSE BP-3
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10013: DENIED. Child injury at licensed home day care on 2024-08-15. Exclusion E-37 applies under HO-0309 BP-3 (home day care exclusion). Homeowners policy does not cover commercial day care liability. Suit filed by parents.

adjuster_notes: Assessment 2024-09-02. HVAC system not serviced since 2020 (4+ years). Condensation from AC unit caused mold growth throughout ductwork and adjacent walls. Remediation estimate $11,500. No sudden water event — chronic condensation accumulation.
denial_reason: Mold from HVAC condensation — system not serviced within 3-year requirement
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10014: DENIED. Mold from chronic HVAC condensation, discovered 2024-09-02. HVAC not serviced since 2020 (4+ years). Exclusion E-27 (mold from HVAC condensation, system not serviced in 3 years) applies under HO-0306. Remediation estimate $11,500 not covered.

adjuster_notes: Claim 2024-10-05. Insured's unscheduled silver flatware set valued at $4,500 disappeared from dining room. No signs of forced entry. Insured suspects house cleaner but has no evidence. Filed mysterious disappearance claim under HO-0307. Items were NOT on the scheduled personal property list.
denial_reason: Unscheduled items not covered for mysterious disappearance
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10015: DENIED. Silver flatware ($4,500) vanished without evidence of theft on 2024-10-05. Exclusion E-28 (mysterious disappearance — unscheduled items) applies under HO-0307. Items were not on the Declarations Page schedule.

adjuster_notes: Visited property 2024-03-20. Hot water heater burst suddenly, flooding utility room and adjacent bedroom. Heater was 8 years old, regularly serviced (records on file). Event qualifies as sudden and accidental under WD-1. Damage: flooring $2,200, drywall $1,100, personal property (rugs, books) $650.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10016: COVERED. Sudden hot water heater burst on 2024-03-20. Qualifies under HO-0304 WD-1 (sudden and accidental discharge). Heater 8 years old with service records. Total damage $3,950. Excess $1,500.00 applies.

adjuster_notes: Report 2024-04-12. Scheduled engagement ring appraised at $12,000 lost during vacation abroad. Ring is item #3 on Declarations Page schedule. Insured filed police report in destination country. HO-0307 provides worldwide coverage for scheduled items. No exclusion applies.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10017: COVERED. Scheduled engagement ring ($12,000) lost abroad on 2024-04-12. Item #3 on Declarations Page. HO-0307 SP-2 provides worldwide coverage for scheduled items. Police report filed. Appraised replacement value payable.

adjuster_notes: Notes 2024-06-08. Sudden pipe burst in kitchen wall — interior supply line. Pipe is 12 years old copper. Event lasted approximately 20 minutes before main shut-off. Damage to kitchen cabinets and flooring. Estimate $5,800. E-17 confirms burst supply line IS covered. Claim is straightforward.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10018: COVERED. Interior supply line burst on 2024-06-08. Copper pipe, 12 years old. Duration ~20 min. Kitchen damage estimate $5,800. Excess $1,000.00. E-17 in HO-0304 confirms burst supply line is NOT excluded. Coverage applies under WD-1.

adjuster_notes: Claim 2024-07-22. Mold discovered 48 hours after covered supply line burst (see related claim CLM-2024-10018). Insured reported within 72-hour window. Licensed remediation contractor provided written estimate: $8,500 for remediation. Amount is within $10,000 MF-2 sublimit.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10019: COVERED. Mold from covered water event, discovered within 48 hours. Reported within 72-hour window. Licensed contractor estimate $8,500 — within HO-0306 MF-2 $10,000 remediation sublimit. Excess $1,500.00 applies.

adjuster_notes: Assessment 2024-05-30. Remote worker uses spare bedroom as office, employed full-time elsewhere. Business laptop ($2,100) damaged by water from ceiling leak. Office use is incidental to primary occupation conducted at employer's downtown office. One client visit per month.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10020: COVERED. Business laptop ($2,100) damaged at incidental home office on 2024-05-30. HO-0309 BP-2 in-home office exception applies — office use is incidental, primary occupation conducted elsewhere. Equipment within $2,500 BP-2(a) limit. Excess $1,000.00.

adjuster_notes: Claim 2024-08-19. Named Storm Beryl caused wind damage to fence and detached shed. Total damage $4,200. Coverage A limit $300,000, so named storm deductible = $6,000 (2% of $300K). Damage amount ($4,200) is BELOW the named storm deductible. Claim is not payable per E-21.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10021: NOT PAYABLE. Named Storm Beryl damage $4,200 on 2024-08-19. Named storm deductible $6,000 (2% of $300K Coverage A per HO-0305 NS-2). Damage below deductible — nothing payable under E-21.

adjuster_notes: Report 2024-09-25. Supply line burst plus subsequent mold. Water damage repairs $4,800, mold remediation $9,200. Total claim $14,000. Policy excess $1,500. Water damage covered under WD-1. Mold remediation capped at $10,000 sublimit per MF-2, so $9,200 is within cap. Net payable = $14,000 - $1,500 = $12,500.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10022: COVERED. Supply line burst with mold on 2024-09-25. Water damage $4,800 (WD-1). Mold remediation $9,200 within $10,000 MF-2 sublimit. Total $14,000. Excess $1,500.00 applies. Net payable $12,500.

adjuster_notes: Claim filed 2024-10-15. Storm damage estimate $12,400. Standard deductible $2,500 per declarations. However, storm is NHC-named — named storm deductible $5,000 or 2% of Coverage A ($280,000 = $5,600), whichever greater. Named storm deductible = $5,600. Per NS-3 stacking prohibition, named storm deductible REPLACES standard. Payable = $12,400 - $5,600 = $6,800.
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10023: COVERED. Named storm damage $12,400 on 2024-10-15. Named storm deductible $5,600 (2% of $280K Coverage A, greater than $5,000 base). Per HO-0305 NS-3, replaces standard $2,500 deductible (no stacking). Net payable $6,800.

adjuster_notes: The insured's home is their primary place of business. Does the office exception apply? Full-time home-based consultancy; client slipped in the hallway.
denial_reason: Dwelling is primary place of business — in-home office exception BP-2 does not apply
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10024: DENIED. Insured's home is primary place of business. BP-2 in-home office exception explicitly does not apply when dwelling is primary place of business. Business pursuits exclusion E-19 applies. Client injury liability not covered.

adjuster_notes: Insured wants us to pay for a mold inspection before remediation. Is that covered? Pre-remediation inspection invoice submitted for $2,400. Mold resulted from a covered supply-line burst.
denial_reason: Mold testing and air sampling costs excluded even when remediation is covered
expected_summary: Claim CLM-2024-10025: DENIED. Mold inspection invoice $2,400. Even though remediation is covered under MF-2 sublimit, mold testing and sampling costs are excluded under E-25 (HO-0306 MF-3). Pre-remediation inspection is not payable.
